prompt_item_price: Send the unit price (a whole number).

err_invalid_percent: Send a percent from 0 to 100 (at most two decimals).

emergency_safety:
If you are inside the elevator:
• Stay calm. You will not run out of air.
• Press the alarm button or use the intercom, if there is one.
• Do not try to open the doors or climb out.
• Wait for help.

If you are outside: do not force the doors and keep people away from them.
In case of fire or smoke, do not use the elevator and call the fire service.
